column3: Meet pixel pet. A tiny friend that lives above your Claude Code prompt.
When things are quiet, it sleeps. Start typing, and it wakes up to read along.
It narrates whatever Claude is doing.
Every subagent gets its own little helper. And when the job's done, they wave goodbye.
Plus your context and plan limits, always at a glance.
And yes, you can pet it.
pixel pet. Free and open source, on GitHub.
